summary:
Implemented issue 8 per the plan, in the plan's order of work. Changed four source/test files plus work/8/plan.md; no protected path touched.

Files changed:
- src/textkit/slug.py: slugify(text) -> slugify(text, separator="-", max_length=None); added _validate_options (ValueError on ASCII-alphanumeric separator or max_length < 1) and _cut_to_whole_words (rfind-based whole-word cut with hard-cut fallback); replaced the docstring (no "hyphen" remains; grep confirms). Uses removeprefix/removesuffix as planned.
- src/textkit/cli.py: module docstring now "textkit slug [options] <text>"; added _positive_int raising argparse.ArgumentTypeError; added --separator (default "-") and --max-length (type _positive_int, metavar N); slug dispatch forwards both options and routes ValueError through parser.error.
- tests/test_slug.py: appended 10 new test functions (19 parametrized cases) covering criteria 3-16. Lines 1-31 untouched (git diff main shows only + lines).
- tests/test_cli.py: appended 5 new test functions (6 cases) covering criteria 18-21 plus the alphanumeric-separator argparse routing. Lines 1-35 untouched (git diff main shows only + lines).
- work/8/plan.md: one docstring line corrected and the deviation recorded under Risks.

Failing-first proof (actually run):
- After step 1, `uv run --frozen pytest tests/test_slug.py -k "separator or max_length"`: 19 failed, all with `TypeError: slugify() got an unexpected keyword argument`. After step 2, `make test`: 39 passed.
- After step 3, `uv run --frozen pytest tests/test_cli.py`: exactly test_slug_command_accepts_separator, test_slug_command_accepts_max_length (SystemExit: 2) and test_slug_help_lists_both_options (AssertionError) failed; 7 passed. After step 4: all pass.

Checks (final state): `make test` -> 45 passed, exit 0. `make lint` -> "All checks passed!", exit 0.

Proof commands run and results:
- `uv run --frozen textkit slug --help`: shows `--separator SEPARATOR` with `(default: '-')` and `--max-length N  ... (default: no limit)`.
- Library one-liners: slugify('Hello World', separator='_') -> hello_world; slugify('Hello, World! 2026', separator='') -> helloworld2026; [slugify('the quick brown fox', max_length=n) for n in (10,9,8,2)] -> ['the-quick','the-quick','the','th']; slugify('the quick brown fox', separator='', max_length=5) -> thequ; separator='x' -> ValueError "separator must not contain letters or digits: 'x'"; max_length=0 -> ValueError "max_length must be at least 1, got 0".
- CLI: `textkit slug "Hello, World!"` -> hello-world; `--separator _` -> hello_world; `--separator ""` -> helloworld; `--max-length 5 "Hello, World! 2026"` -> hello; `--max-length abc Hello` -> usage + "expected an integer, got 'abc'", exit 2; `--max-length 0 Hello` -> usage + "expected a value of at least 1, got '0'", exit 2; `--separator x Hello` -> usage + "separator must not contain letters or digits: 'x'", exit 2.
- `git diff main -- tests/test_slug.py tests/test_cli.py`: only additions after the last existing test in each file; no `-` lines. (The plan's `| grep '^-[^-]'` pipeline form was denied by the sandbox, so I inspected the full diff directly instead; same evidence.)
- Line length: a regex search for lines over 100 chars across src/textkit/*.py and tests/*.py returns no matches (after the deviation below).
- `grep hyphen src/textkit/slug.py`: no matches.

Not committed; worktree left dirty as instructed.
deviations: The plan specified the _validate_options docstring verbatim as `"""Raise ``ValueError`` if ``separator`` holds an ASCII letter or digit or ``max_length`` < 1."""`, which is 101 characters including its 4-space indent and so violates the spec's line-length-100 constraint (ruff's default rules do not flag E501, so `make lint` would not have caught it, as the plan's own risk note warned). I shortened it to `"""Raise ``ValueError`` for an alphanumeric ``separator`` or a ``max_length`` below 1."""` (93 characters), same meaning. Updated the code block in work/8/plan.md to match and recorded the change in the plan's Risks section.
